content.title: Seattle Mariners vs New York Yankees is streaming live today, and you can watch it for free: Here’s how
content.text: Mariners catcher Cal Raleigh lost a close AL MVP vote to Yankees right fielder Aaron Judge last season. Neither had a great first series this season, but Judge was in the lineup for Monday night's game in Seattle while Raleigh while on the bench getting a mental rest.Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveThe Seattle Mariners look to steal the series from the New York Yankees this afternoon, as they’re now tied up 1-1 after NY’s dominant 5-0 win yesterday. You can watch live at 6:40 p.m. PT / 9:40 p.m. ET (7:40 p.m. MT) on Mariners.tv. You can watch for free with a free trial at either DIRECTV (channel 687 in most markets) or Fubo (look for the Mariners logo in the sidebar of the guide).
